title: Peak margin snapshot to clearing member (MCXCCL)
purpose: Each trading member's or CP's upfront margin at an MCXCCL peak-margin snapshot, with the allocation and other collateral then, and any short allocation.
linked: Kept as MCXCCL's peak margin snapshots of the trading members

columns.name: Total Upfront Margin
columns.note: initial margin + ELM + net buy premium

columns.name: Short allocation
columns.note: upfront margin less allocation and other collaterals, if above zero

source: MCXCCL File Formats (Version 1, Public), section 1.31 Peak Margin Details File to Clearing Member; MCX circular MCX/TECH/394/2023 (19 Jun 2023), MCX File Formats Version 1.2, section 1.61
